acceptance: Failed/timed-out join with live child; child exits before spawn returns; failed spawn; held final cleanup; duplicate receipt; uncertain completion during stop. Both observation and ownership are checked.
detail: On lane/wrapper 4e0e11c78 fn-fs-actor-step turns (:joined nil) into joined/fault and registered-p becomes nil. Retain registration until observed physical termination, escalating fault separately. Reserve identity before spawn or use a start latch so early child exit is retained.
title: Prototype actor join failure discharges a potentially live worker registration
